faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Punjabi University Patiala Law Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Law Officer (Legal Advisor) post is 05-10-2026. Ensure your application reaches the authorities before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Law Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor or Master Degree in Law from a recognized University and be registered with the Bar Council of India. Relevant experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Law Officer (Legal Advisor) position is 62 years. No minimum age limit is specified.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for the Law Officer position?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for both General/OBC and SC/ST categories. This fee needs to be paid as per the instructions in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Law Officer (Legal Advisor) role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Merit List followed by an Interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a contractual or permanent job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Law Officer (Legal Advisor) post is on a contractual basis. Details regarding the contract duration will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjabi University Patiala, the link for which is provided in the 'Important Links' section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Law Officer (Legal Advisor) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for this post?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates need to fill the form and send it to the specified address.
